plan.notes: QUARTER CREDITS. Source: Academy College 2025-2027 Catalog (34th edition, effective July 7, 2025), AAS Aviation Business program outline (AVB). Catalog section minimums sum exactly to the catalog header total of 95 quarter credits (Aviation Ground & Flight 5 + Aviation Course Electives 24 + Business and Computer Science 18 + Technical Course Electives 18 + General Education 30). The catalog outline is not semester-sequenced; sections below use the catalog's own section names. Per-course prerequisites are not published in the program outline (prereq left empty; see course descriptions in catalog for details). Elective blocks are modeled as single choice slots at the catalog's stated block-credit value. QUARTER MODELING NOTE: the catalog publishes program outlines by curriculum section, not a term-by-term map. The 6 quarters above are an editorial distribution of all catalog-listed courses/sections (~15.8 quarter credits each); confirm sequencing with an advisor. All credits are QUARTER credits.

courses.choice_note: A minimum of 18 credits. Students may choose from 1000 level and above technical category courses provided prerequisites are met. Review technical electives when considering transferring into one of the Bachelor Degree programs.

courses.choice_note: A minimum of 15 additional credits (required). Including required courses, students must choose a minimum of one (1) course from each discipline depending on prerequisites. Discipline areas: Communications, Humanities, Math/Natural Science, Social Sciences.
